2.text: “Mbese amagambo y'amakabya ntakwiriye gusubizwa?Umuntu yatsindishirizwa n'uko ari imvuganyi?

3.text: Cyangwa abantu bakwiriye gucecekeshwa no kwirata kwawe?Igihe usuzugura nta wagukoza isoni?

4.text: Kuko uvuga uti ‘Ibyo nigisha biratunganye,Ndi intungane mu maso yawe.’

5.text: Ariko icyampa Imana ikavuga,Ikakubumburiraho iminwa yayo,

6.text: Ikakwereka ibihishwe by'ubwenge,Bukoresha uburyo bwinshi.Noneho umenye yuko Imana itaguhannye,Nk'uko ibyaha byawe bikwiriye.

7.text: “Mbese wabasha kugenzura Imana ukayimenya?Wabasha kumenya Ishoborabyose ukarangiza?

8.text: Biri hejuru nk'ijuru, wabigira ute?Biri hasi kuruta ikuzimu, wabimenya ute?

9.text: Urugero rwabyo rusumba isi,N'ubugari bwabyo buruta inyanja.

10.text: Iyo ihise igakinga,igatumira abantu kujya mu rubanza,Ni nde wabasha kuyibuza?

11.text: Kuko itayobewe abantu b'ubusa,Ibona n'ibigoryi,Mbese yabyirengagiza?

12.text: Ariko umuntu w'ubusa abura ubwenge,Ni ukuri umuntu avuka nk'inyana y'imparage.

14.text: Niba hari ikibi mu kuboko kwawe ugite kure,Kandi we kwemera ko gukiranirwa kuba mu rugo rwawe.

15.text: Ni ukuri ni ho uzubura amaso yawe udafite ikizinga,Uzakomera kandi ntabwo uzatinya,

16.text: Kuko uzibagirwa umubabaro wawe,Uzawibuka nk'amazi amaze gutemba.

17.text: Kandi ubugingo bwawe buzarabagirana kurusha amanywa y'ihangu,Naho haba umwijima hazatambika umuseke.

18.text: Kandi uzaba amahoro kuko hariho ibyiringiro,Ni ukuri uzakebuka ibigukikije,wiruhukire mu mahoro.

19.text: Uzaryama he kugira ugutera ubwoba,Ni ukuri benshi bazaguhakwaho.

20.text: Ariko amaso y'abanyabyaha aziheba,Kandi ntibazabona aho guhungira,N'ibyiringiro byabo bizaba guheza umwuka.”
